blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY—For the first time in its history, the Army’s 10th Infantry Division (10ID) brought a national military tradition to Davao de Oro to honor a retiring combat veteran. The division feted Brig. Gen. Apollo Jun Lamaton, commander of the 1002nd Infantry Brigade, with a testimonial parade at the division headquarters in Mawab town on Tuesday, marking the culmination of a 30-year military career. In an emailed advisory, Maj. Ruben Gadut, 10ID spokesman, said that Maj. Gen. Alvin Luzon, division commander, organized the ceremony that is traditionally reserved for the Army’s main headquarters to pay tribute to Lamaton’s extensive […]...
